subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A place for wrestling
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arena**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arena **is a word that specifically refers to a place for wrestling. (कुश्ती के लिए एक जगह)
 
• It can also be used to describe a place for other sports or events that require a large open space.
 
 
• **Example**: *The wrestling match was held in an arena that could accommodate thousands of spectators.*
 
 

Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cemetery**: A place where dead bodies are buried or cremated. (कब्रिस्तान)
 
• **Hangar**: A large building where aircraft are kept and maintained. (जहाँ विमान रखे जाते हैं और उनका रख-रखाव किया जाता है)
 
• **Premise**: A building or piece of land with its buildings and appurtenances, used for business or residential purposes. (घर और उस में मिली हुई भूमि)
